notes.title: The Secrets of the Mayor
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Neighbor![/h1]

I’m here to bring you some information I’ve collected while observing our Mayor. Know that I’ve been watching him vigilantly – though from afar – for quite some time now. If there’s one thing I can be certain of is that he is a man of many faces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/2b90706f3a9e224df507be5898bcfb8604db94c3.png[/img]

To the rich of our Town, he is their friend. Always in their corner. Always ready to help them when they need him most. But I’ve watched him closely enough to know that he’s no knight in shining armor. There seems to be a strong correlation between the way our biggest business takes a hit in order to eventually be forced to ask the Mayor for a handout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/7a42b76ef23c02d8d5a80693279e7a92c8aca460.png[/img]

To the poor, he might as well be the Devil himself. He doesn’t just use fake taxes in order to raise his political capital. He actively uses deception and seemingly positive bills in order to drive some of our fellow neighbors to the brink of craziness. Some manage to stay afloat. Others have been forced to join the ever-growing community of the homeless.

I wouldn’t want to take a side in this political battle, but it does seem mighty suspicious that The Mayor ran unopposed for three election cycles in a row…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/a73f6d547528cc433791e10579c12c025e3192e1.png[/img]

[h3]Twisting the inspirations[/h3]
Our first idea for the Mayor was a “twisted version” of Canada's poster boy Prime Minister. Though when we started to get into the details of the character, the Mayor seemed to take on a life of his own. That said, visually we still kept some inspiration for the look of the character. That puffy hair was just too good of an image.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/e243bb7c144957078e8a126ada67651258dd727b.png[/img]

The Mayor, as a major character in the story, went through a couple of designs as we were still exploring the options for how our NPCs will look.

While we distanced ourselves so we didn’t just fall into making specific “Canada jokes”, we noticed that our Mayor became a more layered presence. After all, we will get to meet face-to-face with him in the game, so we couldn’t just rely on one inspiration, especially since the relationship the media has with political leaders is usually distant and cold. We wanted to get as close and personal as we could… while still infusing the character with as many real-world inspirations as possible, eventually looking at a vast range of European and American political figures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/e6ce2bdd540b98f5c818d8fff1aeafea10c323b1.png[/img]

In reality, we wanted to create him in a way that allows us to take inspiration from all over the world. We made him be a blank canvas… or rather an “orange-faced canvas” for us to paint on ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/6dad0070d79104f1f7827d2d1b43e8702a2a5c79.png[/img]

[h3]Look closely[/h3]
There are a couple of visuals we wanted to stand out with our main antagonist.

First of all, his clothes clearly represent the classic color scheme politicians use in order to build an image of trust and respect. That said, we made some twists on the formula. The Mayor is now in his third term in office, so it seemed like an occasion to have some fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/41454062c08838a71d486ebe9719dd89d7c9d261.gif[/img]

This is why we contrasted his seemingly nice smile with eyes that reveal his intelligence and cunning. The clean-cut suit is underscored by small details like a pot supporter pin that must be a way for him to score some easy points with the youth, a suspicious mark on his neck that might reveal he’s not always saying everything about himself, and a tie that’s a clear signal of how serious he really treats his office.

https://youtu.be/26w5WOWdr4Q

[h3]What other secrets does the Mayor have?[/h3]
You’ll soon be able to find out more about the Mayor’s schemes and political plans. In the meantime, be sure to share your thoughts about him on Discord and our Steam community page. We hope you’ll share your ideas and feedback on how we can make The Mayor even more interesting.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1953600/discussions

[url=https://discord.gg/kTbpmFEJnA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/8243a0105adb170acf470e4e26a1d8046d857cd5.png[/img][/url]

That’s all our intelligence was able to gather for now,
Wingard out!

notes.title: The house you always wanted to build!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Neighbor![/h1]

[h3]It’s me, your friendly neighborhood superhero wannabe peeping Tom, Wingard.[/h3]

[b]We all like our houses a certain way. I go for the dark and aged gothic manor vibe myself, but I know fancy halls, giant fireplaces and plentiful displays of art are not for everyone.
But we’re not here to talk about my home – awesome as it may be. What I want to know is how your house is going to look, my dear neighbor?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/39cff737b77ea28c0d64c15e16cb9676eb7a7e7f.png[/img]

[h3][b]Lots of Rooms[/b][/h3]

There are plenty of options at your disposal. Starting from the carefully crafted collections of items for each part of the house:

-          Entry Hall
-          Bedroom
-          Living room
-          Kitchen
-          Dining room
-          Bathroom
-          Toilet room
-          Wardrobe
-          Study
-          Washing room
-          Pantry

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/d57cb283a7ec684d27146cac5cd63b2ecffcd354.png[/img]

[h3][b]Plenty of Styles[/b][/h3]

These collections will include hand-crafted items, representing a variety of styles, such as:
-          Scandinavian
-          Rustic
-          Modern
-          Classic
-          Industrial (loft)
-          Eclectic
-          Glamour
-          Vintage
-          Boho
-          Hampton
-          Art Déco
-          Provencal

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/3c3a497cff213296371cefa73e3cd3b80b8a1fc5.png[/img]

[h3][b]That’s not all![/b][/h3]

We will also consider creating special fan-requested items, so if you dream of building your house around an iron chair with swords sticking out or you feel like a billiard table would be the perfect centerpiece for your avatar’s living room, or if you have any other out-of-the-box ideas, be sure to inform us on Discord and in our Steam Community group!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1953600/discussions/0/5479214724376528022
https://discord.gg/GHrP34zHCJ

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/f8be861b38019a98d40e5806e984ba7778df29cf.png[/img]

[h3][b]Play it soon[/b][/h3]

Election Town’s building mode is a sandbox with a variety of options, just waiting for you to explore. The intuitive drag-and-drop control system might be simple to use, but don’t let that fool you into thinking there won’t be some depth to it.

We can’t wait for you to get your hands on an early version of our building mode when you play the Demo on next month’s Steam Next Fest.

We look forward to hearing all your feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953600/Election_Town/

[h3][b]Take part in our contest on Discord[/b][/h3]

[i][b]Between 15.09.2022 - 18.09.2022, we’ll be hosting a contest on Discord. Show off your talent for decorating a room in real life or send us ideas for possible furniture pieces we can add to a game and get a chance to win game codes for our other games :)[/b][/i]

[url=https://discord.gg/kTbpmFEJnA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/8243a0105adb170acf470e4e26a1d8046d857cd5.png[/img][/url]

As for now, Wingard out!
See you on Discord!

notes.title: Welcome to Election Town!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Election Town![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/b361c7b450ba3fdffff652b18c4f9a3d1706fc5c.png[/img]

[h3]I’m Wingard, the watchful guardian of Election Town. I will be your guide through the months leading up to the release of the game.

Let me start by inviting you to our Discord server, where you’ll be able to talk with me about the game, give us your ideas and share your thoughts on the demo, which you’ll soon be able to play yourself.[/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/kTbpmFEJnA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/8243a0105adb170acf470e4e26a1d8046d857cd5.png[/img][/url]

The last few months were very busy for our team, not only in the conceptual phase but also with the game itself. There are a lot of changes going on. Certainly, the biggest of them is the new name of the game: [b]Election Town.[/b]

The decision to change the title became simple, once we identified the core story of the game. Also, as of now, that’s what we’re calling the city we’re building for you :)

In the coming months, we’re going to prepare some competitions for you, but we’ll also share some elements of our world as it’s coming together. You’ll get a chance to get the best seat to experience the adventure of creating this game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/6402818bc152cc6d70a2514e27e8604ca98c183a.png[/img]

[h3]In the meantime, I wanted to assure you that a playable demo will 100% be available on Steam Next Fest in less than a month.[/h3]

That’s all we have for now. See you around on Steam and on Discord!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953600/Election_Town/

Best Regards,
Wingard

notes.title: Election Town devlog 1
notes.content:
[h1]Hey mates![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/cdce74518d4db23baf1046cdce2b3fce0f33d35b.png[/img]

[h3]This is our first devlog, we are working hard on improving the game. 
At least once a month we will show the progress of our work. We would like to announce that we will be participating in the [b]Steam Next Fest: October 2022[/b]! Let's start by introducing information about the game.[/h3]

[h2]Election Town[/h2]
The game will combine elements of building, buying, and managing your apartment, but the main gameplay will be about life in the suburbs. Also will show in a humorous way life in the suburbs, but it will not be without intrigue, conspiracies, and twists and turns. 

We also want to put a lot of emphasis on the script. The game will have a simple life simulation system, the player's character will have to meet such simple needs as eating, drinking, personal hygiene, or leisure.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
We want to show you that we are working on the game and we have prepared a special video for you - Let us know what you think about it! 

[previewyoutube=z2PiYBgpao4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Schedule for the future:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/854be68938803ca8619d602f110c6d6ed716b8f1.png[/img]

In the coming months, you can expect a lot of surprises for the players! 

[b]What kind of things do you expect to appear in the game? What elements of the construction of the house elements and interior design would you like to be added? Send us your feedback - Your opinions are very important to us![/b]

Be sure to follow our discord channel for more PolyVersum content!

[url=https://discord.gg/kTbpmFEJnA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42231180/8243a0105adb170acf470e4e26a1d8046d857cd5.png[/img][/url]

Best Regards,
PolyGods Team
